episodic_summary: As of 9 August, 2023, Maria checks in with John, asking about what has been going on in his life. Maria shares that last week, she volunteered at a homeless shelter and received a medal for her efforts, expressing that it was a humbling experience and she is glad to have helped. Maria shows a photography of a medal hanging from a tree with a ribbon. John congratulates Maria on her recognition and expresses how touching it is to see how much she is doing to help others. John mentions that last weekend, he participated in a community event to raise money for a good cause, noting the great turnout and how amazing it was to be surrounded by many supportive people. John shares a photo of a young girl holding a sign in her hands. Maria finds John's experience inspiring and comments on the heartwarming picture of the little girl with a cute smile, asking what the event was about. John explains that they set up a 5K charity run in their neighborhood to help veterans' families and that they were able to raise some funds. He shares a photo of a group of people posing for a picture from the event. Maria praises John's efforts, calling it an important cause and expressing her honor in knowing someone like him who takes initiative. She describes the photo shared as powerful and asks John to tell her more about how he organized the run. John thanks Maria, stating that her support means a lot to him. He shows a photo of a map of the streets of downtown. Maria acknowledges the effort John put in and asks if there were any challenges along the way. John confirms that getting sponsors was difficult, as he had to reach out to several businesses through different means, but it paid off as they ended up with awesome sponsors that made the event a hit.
